task_text: Cooperative puck course: A low-friction puck is already sliding across the table toward the left arm when the episode starts. The two Pandas each hold a paddle and must hit the same puck in turn: left, right, left, right. After each of the first three hits the puck must pass through a different gap in a row of posts standing across the table between the arms. First it goes toward the right arm through the gap at the -y end. Then it goes back toward the left arm through the gap at the +y end, next to a side rail. Then it goes toward the right arm again through the middle gap. The right arm's final hit must send the puck across a goal line in front of a backstop wall on the right arm's side. Phases, in order: left_first_pass: First, a strike by the left paddle is registered: the first moment in this phase when the puck touches the left paddle while the paddle body moves faster than 0.035 m/s, more than 0.06 s after the previous registered strike. Only that first qualifying contact counts as the strike; later touches are allowed but do not register again. Then, more than 0.035 s after the strike and while the puck is not touching the left paddle, the puck's centre crosses the line x = 0.12 moving in +x, with |y - (-0.13)| < 0.055 m. Moving in +x means x was <= 0.12 on the previous physics step and is > 0.12 now. This line passes through the gap between the first and second posts from the -y side.; right_return_route: A strike by the right paddle is registered under the same rule: the puck touches the right paddle while that paddle moves faster than 0.035 m/s, more than 0.06 s after the previous registered strike. Then, more than 0.035 s after it and while the puck is not touching the right paddle, the puck's centre crosses x = 0.12 moving in -x, with |y - 0.19| < 0.055 m. This is the gap between the third and fourth posts, next to the side rail.; left_diagonal_pass: A strike by the left paddle is registered (same rule). Then, more than 0.035 s after it and while the puck is not touching the left paddle, the puck's centre crosses x = 0.12 moving in +x, with |y - 0.025| < 0.055 m. This is the middle gap, between the second and third posts.; right_terminal_shot: A strike by the right paddle is registered (same rule). Then, more than 0.035 s after it and while the puck is not touching the right paddle, the puck's centre crosses x = 0.46 moving in +x, with |y - (-0.02)| < 0.05 m. This is the goal line in front of the backstop. This completes the task. Goal geometry: The puck's centre must cross three passage lines. P0 = (0.12, -0.13), P1 = (0.12, 0.19) and P2 = (0.12, 0.025); each is a crossing of x = 0.12 with |y - y_P| < 0.055 m. The goal line, is a crossing of x = 0.46 in +x with |y + 0.02| < 0.05 m.
